findings.title: PMKID disclosed in EAPOL message 1
findings.detail: AP 30:86:2d:c0:07:c0 ("WPA3") included a PMKID in message 1. Because the PMKID is HMAC-SHA1(PMK, "PMK Name" || AP || STA), this one frame supports an offline dictionary attack on the passphrase with no client and no full handshake required
evidence: remediation: WPA3-SAE, or disable PMKID caching on the AP
